project_name: Shree Stay Homes & PG Billing & Invoice Generator

theme_strategy.rationale: For an invoice generator and PG dashboard, a light theme is required for maximum legibility of tabular data, seamless print-to-PDF fidelity, and establishing a professional, trustworthy aesthetic.

emotional_archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Soft Utility

headings.usage: Use font-extrabold and tracking-tight for H1/H2 dashboard titles to provide structural, architectural confidence. Use font-medium for card headers.

body.usage: Highly legible for dense invoice data, pricing tables, and numerical input.

colors.tailwind_config_instructions: Extend tailwind colors with 'stone' as the base neutral, and 'terracotta' (#D85C40) as the primary brand color to give it a warm, brick/home feel. AVOID teal green, teal blue, or generic SaaS blue (#2563EB).

surface_strategy.inputs: bg-[#FDFCFB] border border-[#E6E4E0] focus:border-[#D85C40] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D85C40]

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 for main dashboard cards, p-4 for list items.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, solid white background, 1px right border (border-stone-200). DO NOT use glassmorphism.
grids_and_layouts.metrics_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Children must stretch to fill heights. Use sharp structural alignment.
grids_and_layouts.invoice_form: Two-column grid layout for desktop (lg:grid-cols-12), where form takes col-span-8 and live preview takes col-span-4.

components.library: shadcn/ui (JavaScript/JSX versions only, DO NOT use TSX)
components.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop must be bg-stone-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm. Modals must be solid white with rounded-xl.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. No outer borders, just subtle border-b (border-stone-100) between rows. Text sizes should be text-sm.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-terracotta-500 text-white hover:bg-terracotta-600 rounded-md px-6. Secondary: border border-stone-200 bg-white hover:bg-stone-50 rounded-md.
components.badges: For payment status (Paid, Pending): Use subtle tinted backgrounds (bg-green-50 text-green-700, bg-amber-50 text-amber-700) with rounded-full.

visual_enhancers.offline_indicator: A permanent, subtle top-bar or bottom-left toast indicator stating 'Offline Mode - Changes saved locally' using a warning color.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Generous vertical padding (py-24), a subtle gray Lucide icon (size 48), and clear 'Create First Invoice' CTA.
visual_enhancers.invoice_watermark: When generating PDF, place the PG Logo directly in the center with 10% opacity, angled at -30 degrees.

motion.interactions: Hover states on table rows: bg-stone-50 transition-colors duration-150. Button hover: -translate-y-[1px] shadow-sm.
motion.page_transitions: None required for functional speed, but use Framer Motion for a subtle stagger-in effect on dashboard metric cards (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> 1).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text primary/secondary passes WCAG AA against the stone-50 background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-terracotta-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, inputs, and buttons MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-invoice-button').

auth_background.description: Warm, modern, neutral bedroom interior to be used as a split-screen background image for the login/auth page.

decorative_pattern.description: Abstract white architectural ribs. Can be used at 5% opacity for empty states or dashboard headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with the 'stone' and 'terracotta' color palette. Define specific theme variables for background, surface, and text.
Use JavaScript (.js or .jsx) exclusively for React files. Do not use TypeScript.
For the Invoice creation form, implement live INR calculations dynamically as the user types rent, electricity, maintenance, etc.
Use localForage or the native IndexedDB API for offline-first data storage. Ensure all operations (create, edit, delete invoice) update IndexedDB first.
For the PDF generation, use jsPDF + autoTable. Ensure the layout mimics the on-screen view closely, injecting the uploaded PG logo at the top and as a watermark.
Include a 'data-testid' attribute on every input, button, and dynamic table row to support end-to-end testing.
Build the dashboard using pure structural layouts. Avoid nesting cards within cards. Use Shadcn Table for Invoice History and Tenants.
Implement the Settings page with native file input (FileReader API) to convert uploaded logos/signatures to Base64 and store them in IndexedDB.
In the Backup/Restore tab, generate a downloadable JSON file containing the IndexedDB state for export, and read a JSON file to overwrite IndexedDB for import.
For emails, hit the FastAPI backend endpoint containing the Resend API logic, passing the Base64 PDF.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge towards generic, on-distribution outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Use pure flat design with structural 1px borders rather than heavy drop shadows.
Ensure all interactive components have clearly defined hover, active, and focus states.
Avoid using AI assistant emojis in UI text.
Do not apply global transitions (e.g., transition: all).
Never use generic placeholder URLs for images. Use the ones provided in the image_urls section.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications to provide immediate offline/sync status feedback.
Maintain high density in tables and forms, but generous padding around page containers.
